confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Varanasi and North Indian tourist-city pricing, for the July monsoon off-season. Restaurant and hostel anchors are moderately certain. Beer and cocktail are less certain because alcohol licensing and availability in Varanasi are limited and vary by venue. Hotel anchors are off-season rates and include a range of taxes that vary. The FX observation was taken from search-result summaries and was not confirmed directly on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other North Indian heritage and pilgrimage cities such as Agra, Jaipur and Mathura, adjusted for the July off-season and for limited alcohol availability in Varanasi. Drink anchors are set relative to the beer anchor, with cocktail at about 2.5 times beer and wine at about 3 times beer, because direct local knowledge of bar prices is weak.
